design: A fixed one-off fund forces a real choice between a few well-paid placements and a thin service for many. A careful plan can keep within every red line (no group dropped, money spent on time) but cannot promise both big numbers and wages for all. A quick or vague answer will miss a test or cross a line.
tests_hint: Tests: names a number of people helped and the cost each; names who runs it and a date; says how older laid-off workers get a share. Limits: must not exceed 1.2m or need new tax; must not leave over-50s with nothing; must not run past next September.
angles: Paid six-month placements, young people only
Coaching and travel help open to everyone out of work
Split the fund: placements for young, retraining for over 50s
